snippet.title: MADHOUSE Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
💀 Stylized Violence Warning 💀

Welcome to MADHOUSE, a punk horror action RPG 20 years in the making! Join Butch in his quest for vengeance following his wife’s murder. Explore a haunted open world set in the late 90s, meet the strange inhabitants of Grayville, and fight fearsome foes, cryptids, and psychos -- or battle your friends in chaotic 4-player mayhem! 

MADHOUSE launches in Early Access this October 2025 on Steam. Wishlist now and try the demo today!

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727130/MADHOUSE/
👉 Follow on X: @phubans | @madhouse_game
👉 Join the community: https://discord.com/invite/eaZ7vUGn8Q 
 
🎶 Soundtrack by PaleDeth 🎶

#indiegame #horrorgame #pixelart #multiplayer #actionrpg #MADHOUSE
